text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик bakes a huge batch of
madeleines to
give to her friends.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: But... I'm in a bit of a pickle.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I made some for myself as well, but I
spent so
much time handing them out
that it's already
really late...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I can't be eating sweets at this hour...
But still...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Do you think it would be okay for me to
have
some? Just a few.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Don't give in to the temptation...

text_block_list.text:
I actually had a taste, and they were
quite
delicious, so I've been looking
forward to having
some more!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'll work extra hard at training
tomorrow to
make up for it. ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You know, I've been looking forward to
eating
them since I was baking. Ehehe.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'll make some tea while I'm at it.
Would you
like some too?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'll save them for tomorrow morning or
something.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Fight the urge, fight the urge!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик hums a tune as she makes
some tea
and enjoys her madeleines.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик hums to herself as she
makes some
tea and happily digs into
her madeleines.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик squeezes her eyes shut and
stops
herself from eating the
madeleines.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
